S.FORM: Togo hya' ga cyux maki' tay 8 00 N, 1 10 E na Xweco syuw. kwara' kinghciyan niya' 56,785 sq km (maki' tay 126ginkgan kin wahci') (kinwhci' niya' ga 54,385 sq km, kinwhci' na lawsayan wsilung hya' ga 2,400 sq km) Kinkhmayan kwara' squliq hya' ga 7,756,937.
